versions.notes: Mission 2 and the phone are voiced: Sal, the Calder Mutual agent, Dante's new lines and calls.

Wheels mission, Pay 'n' Spray and insurance, the phone, text and directional voice chat, more voice lines, everyday street life and ambience, TVs playing YouTube in sync with 3D sound (Windows and Linux), and a lighter main thread.

The server list works, and the city opens up further.

- Servers: the game and dedicated servers now reach Lowtown's own server list and accounts, so Pelican and other public servers show up in Servers, and you can sign in.
- Every storey of houses, flats and offices is walk-in, with stairs; windows with a room behind them are see-through.
- TVs in the city play one channel, in sync for everyone.
- Smoother driving at speed.

- Lowtown-0.1.2-win64.zip: the game for Windows 10/11 (unzip, run Lowtown.exe).
- Lowtown-0.1.2-linux-x86_64.zip: the game for Linux and the Steam Deck (unzip, run Lowtown.x86_64).
- Lowtown-Server-0.1.2-linux-arm64.zip: the dedicated server for Linux on ARM64, as the Pelican egg installs it.

A pre-release. Players need 0.1.2 to join a 0.1.2 server.

Calder Bay's people talk now, and buildings open up.

- City people speak, each with their own voice, and have more street lines.
- Interiors: walk into homes, shops and workplaces, with people inside.
- A city map and GPS: open the map, set a waypoint, follow the route.
- Faces that blink, talk and move their brows; a men's base body.
- Stray cars get towed; many smaller fixes to people on foot and the city.

- Lowtown-0.1.1-win64.zip: the game for Windows 10/11 (unzip, run Lowtown.exe).
- Lowtown-0.1.1-linux-x86_64.zip: the game for Linux and the Steam Deck (unzip, run Lowtown.x86_64).
- Lowtown-Server-0.1.1-linux-arm64.zip: the dedicated server for Linux on ARM64, as the Pelican egg installs it.

A pre-release. Players need 0.1.1 to join a 0.1.1 server.

First Lowtown build: Calder Bay, a harbour city with traffic, people, police, jobs and shops, alone or online with friends.

- Lowtown-0.1.0-win64.zip: the game for Windows 10/11 (unzip, run Lowtown.exe).
- Lowtown-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.zip: the game for Linux and the Steam Deck (unzip, run Lowtown.x86_64).
- Lowtown-Server-0.1.0-linux-arm64.zip: the dedicated server for Linux on ARM64, as the Pelican egg installs it.

A pre-release: online play has been tested on one PC and the ARM64 server on its own; a player joining the ARM64 server hasn't been tested yet.
